data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 深夜厨房的亲昵喂食
data.description: 私人高层套房现代感十足的极简大理石厨房内，暖黄色射灯打在光洁的料理台上。晴奈换上了宽松的黑金丝绸睡袍，领口微敞露出动人的锁骨。她手持小银勺，轻轻舀起一勺冒着热气的特制浓汤送至老师唇边，眼眸中褪去了所有杀伐果断，只剩下少女般的娇媚与期待。
data.action: holding spoon feeding viewer, leaning forward, playful alluring smile, subtle blush
data.lighting: warm focused spotlighting on marble kitchen counter
data.mood: playful domestic affection, sweet pampering, and culinary intimacy
data.promptProse: Leaning over a sleek marble kitchen counter in her loose black silk robe, Kurodate Haruna offers a silver spoon with a playful, heavily blushing smile.
data.animaCaption: Haruna offering a spoonful of delicacy with an alluring, playful smile in the kitchen.
